intro: A record of Bandwar's infrastructure needs, completed works, and long-term development goals. This document tracks the gap between present reality and future requirements.

completedProjects.title: Plus Two School Building
completedProjects.description: A new pucca building for Plus Two Vidyalaya Vandwar, extending education in the village beyond Class 10 for the first time.

completedProjects.title: Vaani Vilas Pustakalaya
completedProjects.description: A village library built with MPLAD funds under the initiative of Girija Singh — with books, a reading area, and portraits of national leaders.

completedProjects.title: Smart Gram Panchayat — PM-WANI WiFi
completedProjects.description: Begusarai became the first district in Bihar to equip all Gram Panchayats with public WiFi under PM-WANI. Bandwar was among them.

completedProjects.title: Multiple Road Projects
completedProjects.description: Several road projects — from Gandak Bandh to Vandwar Musahri (₹60 lakh), Vandwar Krishna Mandir Chowk to Mohanpur, Parna PCC Road to Hanuman Mandir, and 8 more roads sanctioned.

upcomingProjects.title: Chhath Ghat Construction
upcomingProjects.reality: The village has no proper Chhath Ghat. Every year during Chhath Puja, hundreds of devotees — mostly women — stand on slippery, uneven riverbank steps of the Burhi Gandak to offer arghya.
upcomingProjects.vision: A concrete ghat with safe, non-slip steps leading to the water. Handrails, separate changing rooms, LED lighting, CCTV surveillance, and waste disposal bins.

upcomingProjects.title: Ram Janki Fuels (Petrol Pump Upgrade)
upcomingProjects.scheme: IOCL Dealer Development + PACS Petrol Pump Scheme
upcomingProjects.reality: Ram Janki Fuels serves the village and passing highway traffic on SH 55, but its facilities are minimal. There is no air pressure machine, no clean restroom, and no drinking water.
upcomingProjects.vision: A modern petrol pump with digital dispensers, a free air pressure machine, clean restrooms, an RO drinking water station, and a small convenience store.

upcomingProjects.title: Complete Water Tower Coverage
upcomingProjects.scheme: Jal Jeevan Mission + Har Ghar Nal Ka Jal
upcomingProjects.reality: The Jal Jeevan Mission water tower has been built, but the pipeline network is incomplete. Many households still depend on wells and handpumps.
upcomingProjects.vision: Complete pipeline coverage across the village with every household connected. Monthly water quality testing, chlorination, a toll-free repair helpline, and backup power.

upcomingProjects.title: Internal Pucca Roads
upcomingProjects.reality: The village's internal roads are unpaved. During the monsoon, waterlogging makes them impassable — children can't reach school, patients can't reach the main road.
upcomingProjects.vision: A fully pucca road connecting every ward to the main SH 55, with covered drainage on both sides, LED streetlights, and rainwater harvesting pits.

upcomingProjects.title: Madhya Vidyalaya Modernisation
upcomingProjects.scheme: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan + MPLAD + Khelo India
upcomingProjects.reality: The government middle school operates from a pucca building, but lacks electricity in some rooms, a separate toilet for girls, a computer lab, and a playground.
upcomingProjects.vision: A fully renovated pucca building with solar-powered classrooms, RO drinking water, separate toilets, a computer lab, a library, and a playground.

upcomingProjects.title: Gram Panchayat Bhawan Upgrade
upcomingProjects.scheme: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA) + 15th Finance Commission
upcomingProjects.reality: The Gram Panchayat Bhawan functions, but lacks modern facilities. No proper meeting hall for Gram Sabha, no digital service counter, and no disabled access.
upcomingProjects.vision: An upgraded panchayat bhawan with a meeting hall, a digital service counter (CSC), digitised land records, and full accessibility.

upcomingProjects.title: SBI Branch Expansion
upcomingProjects.authority: State Bank of India, Regional Office
upcomingProjects.reality: The SBI Bandwar branch operates from a small building with limited counter space. Long queues form outside during pension days.
upcomingProjects.vision: An upgraded SBI branch with multiple counters including one dedicated for women, seating for 20+ customers, air conditioning, and a wheelchair-accessible ramp.

upcomingProjects.title: Multi-ATM Facility
upcomingProjects.scheme: SBI ATM Expansion Programme + Financial Inclusion
upcomingProjects.authority: State Bank of India, District Administration
upcomingProjects.reality: The village has only one ATM, which frequently runs out of cash. There is no cash deposit facility.
upcomingProjects.vision: A multi-ATM facility with at least two machines, a cash deposit kiosk (CDM), 24x7 operation, air conditioning, and CCTV surveillance.

upcomingProjects.title: Ram Mandir Thakurbari Renovation
upcomingProjects.scheme: State Cultural Fund + MPLAD + Community Contribution
upcomingProjects.reality: The Ram Mandir Thakurbari needs renovation — the paint is faded, the courtyard is unpaved, and facilities for devotees are minimal.
upcomingProjects.vision: A fully renovated temple with fresh whitewashed twin shikharas, marble flooring, LED evening lighting, a sound system, and a seating area for 100+ devotees.

roadmap.label: Year 1–3
roadmap.title: Foundations
roadmap.focus: Water, roads, drainage, and emergency infrastructure
items: Complete piped water coverage to every household.
Pucca roads connecting every ward to SH 55 with drainage.
Covered storm water drainage to prevent waterlogging.
Upgrade SBI branch and expand ATM facility.
Extend PM-WANI WiFi and digitise Panchayat services.

roadmap.label: Year 4–6
roadmap.title: Institutions
roadmap.focus: Schools, healthcare, panchayat, and public services
items: Modernise Madhya Vidyalaya and S.N.K. High School.
Build a proper civic building with Gram Sabha hall.
Establish a dedicated primary health centre with ambulance.
Solar panels on public buildings and streetlight upgrades.

roadmap.label: Year 7–10
roadmap.title: Heritage & Culture
roadmap.focus: Ghats, temples, public spaces, and community identity
items: Renovate Bandwar's temples and enhance facilities.
Build a proper Chhath Ghat on the Burhi Gandak.
Develop parks, gardens, and seating areas at landmarks.
Create a cultural centre for the village's arts and history.
